phases.caption: Move the left hand to the buckle at the lower end of the image-left shoulder strap and close around it.
Maintain the existing buckle hold, then raise the buckle and attached shoulder strap to release the strap.
Return both arms to the demonstrated rest pose; keep both grippers unchanged.
Move the right hand to the buckle at the lower end of the image-right shoulder strap and close around it.
Maintain the right-hand buckle hold, then raise the buckle and attached strap to release the strap.
Return both arms to the demonstrated rest pose; keep both grippers unchanged.
